text:
mira: Quick sync 1 final green-room checklist for Wed 11am PT webinar. Need demo fallback flow and speaker one-liner.

alex: Agenda done. Who flips the demo route if latency spikes? Need the exact command.

jamal: Im making a 1-pager for speakers: mic checks, visual cues, and a 30s hold line. Will drop draft by EOD.

sara: Ops can run a full preflight at 10:15 PT. I'll push a staging model and prime KV cache.

ops-bot: reminder: Zoom scheduled 2026-03-25T18:00:00Z recording on.

mira: Fallback flow: 1) switch to lower-q model, 2) route to warm-standby, 3) serve cached condensed answers with a banner. Speaker script needed.

alex: Sandbox command for route flip: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/route -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"route":"demo","model":"gpt-small-v2"}'` 

jamal: On-stage cue cards: "Switching to condensed answers to keep latency low" and "Short pause for system fallback (30s)". Non-technical.

sara: Full dry run with speakers + prod + ops at 10:15. @mira confirm speakers.

mira: Confirmed: Priya, Thomas, Dana. Priya wants a 1:1 mic check at 10:05.

alex: We'll run two endpoints: primary + warm-standby (min_instances=1, quantized=true, region=us-west-2). Ops validate cost.

ops-bot: on-call for Wed 11-12 PT: @kevin.

kevin: I'll monitor. Rollback: if p50 > 3s for 2m, flip to cached responses and page team. Posting runbook to #eng-oncall.

jamal: I'll upload green-room PDF to #marketing-assets and paste link here.

mira: Add single-line speaker script for audio hiccups and condensed answers: "We're temporarily on condensed answers to keep things snappy; full examples in the follow-up." :thumbsup: 

sara: Lead routing: if attendees >500 route demo signups to `webinar-high` SDR queue, else `webinar-regular`. Adding to post-demo automation.

mira: Green-room meet 9:50 PT. Thanks all, ping with blockers.
